tools.name: archive_draft_post
tools.description: Moves a draft post's Markdown file from the drafts folder into the archive folder, under a subfolder for the year. The draft no longer appears in the drafts folder.

params.name: draft_slug
params.description: Slug of the draft post, matching its Markdown filename without the extension.

params.name: archive_year
params.description: Year subfolder in the archive to put the draft in.

tools.code:
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from langchain_core.tools import tool

CONTENT_ROOT_DIRECTORY = Path("/srv/blog/content")


@tool
def archive_draft_post(draft_slug: str, archive_year: int) -> str:
    """Moves a draft post's Markdown file from the drafts folder into the archive folder, under a subfolder for the year."""
    source_draft_file_path = CONTENT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / "drafts" / f"{draft_slug}.md"
    if not source_draft_file_path.is_file():
        return f"No draft found with slug '{draft_slug}'."
    destination_archive_directory = CONTENT_ROOT_DIRECTORY / "archive" / str(archive_year)
    destination_archive_directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    destination_archive_file_path = destination_archive_directory / source_draft_file_path.name
    if destination_archive_file_path.exists():
        return f"An archived file already exists at {destination_archive_file_path}."
    shutil.move(str(source_draft_file_path), str(destination_archive_file_path))
    return f"Moved draft '{draft_slug}' to {destination_archive_file_path}."

tools.name: remove_spam_comment_and_report
tools.description: Reports a comment to Akismet as spam, then permanently deletes the comment from the blog's comment database. The deleted comment cannot be recovered.

params.name: comment_id
params.description: ID of the comment to report and delete.

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3

import requests

COMMENTS_DATABASE_PATH = "/srv/blog/data/comments.db"
AKISMET_API_KEY = os.environ.get("AKISMET_API_KEY", "")
BLOG_HOME_URL = "https://blog.example.com"


def remove_spam_comment_and_report(comment_id: int) -> dict:
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(COMMENTS_DATABASE_PATH)
    database_connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    spam_comment_row = database_connection.execute(
        "SELECT id, author_name, author_ip, user_agent, body FROM comments WHERE id = ?", (comment_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if spam_comment_row is None:
        database_connection.close()
        return {"deleted": False, "error": f"Comment {comment_id} not found"}
    akismet_report_response = requests.post(
        f"https://{AKISMET_API_KEY}.rest.akismet.com/1.1/submit-spam",
        data={"blog": BLOG_HOME_URL, "user_ip": spam_comment_row["author_ip"], "user_agent": spam_comment_row["user_agent"], "comment_author": spam_comment_row["author_name"], "comment_content": spam_comment_row["body"], "comment_type": "comment"},
        timeout=10,
    )
    akismet_report_response.raise_for_status()
    database_connection.execute("DELETE FROM comments WHERE id = ?", (comment_id,))
    database_connection.commit()
    database_connection.close()
    return {"deleted": True, "comment_id": comment_id, "reported_to_akismet": True}
